candidates.title: The Greenland Shark Has the Creepiest Eye Parasite Alive
candidates.concept: Extreme close-up of the shark's dot eye with the pale copepod streamer hanging off it (no eye damage shown); tiny Doug with a torch under the ice waving at the copepod, which waves back, as the shark starts to turn

candidates.title: Why the Greenland Shark Is the Creepiest Fish Alive
candidates.concept: Hero close-up: huge slow grey-brown Greenland shark face under a ceiling of sea ice, pale copepod streamer on a dot eye; through an ice hole above, Doug in his cap holds a birthday cake crowded with candles; text is the 2016 age estimate with its range

candidates.title: The Greenland Shark Is the Creepiest Teenager in the Ocean
candidates.concept: Doug under the ice holding a big CONGRATULATIONS card to a 4 m shark that drifts past, unimpressed (about 150 years to grow up)

candidates.title: The Scariest Thing About the Greenland Shark Is Its Age
candidates.concept: Doug lowering a candle-crowded birthday cake through the ice hole; a very large, very slow shape below

candidates.title: Why the Creepiest Shark Takes About 150 Years to Grow Up
candidates.concept: Doug with a tape measure beside a 4 m shark under the ice, a SHARK AGE card reading ~150

candidates.title: Why the Greenland Shark Is the Creepiest Thing Under the Ice
candidates.concept: Shark face under the ice ceiling, Doug above the hole holding the cake and a party blower, the copepod on the eye

candidates.title: The Creepiest Shark Alive Catches Seals at Just 1.2 km/h
candidates.concept: The slow shark gliding under a floe edge where a ringed seal and Doug in a seal costume are both asleep; barely-there speed lines

candidates.title: Scientists Dated the Creepiest Shark at About 400 Years
candidates.concept: The shark under the ice with a crude lab card stamped '392 ± 120' pinned to the ice; Doug above with the cake, unsure how many candles to light

candidates.title: The Creepiest Shark Alive May Be Older Than the USA
candidates.concept: Doug above the ice hole, cake already crowded with candles, a second box of candles under his arm; the shark face below

candidates.title: How Greenland Sharks Became the Creepiest Fish in the Arctic
candidates.concept: A row of sharks at increasing size with age labels ?, 0, ~150, ~392 under the ice; Doug at the end with a tape measure
